purpose.name: Analytics Cookies
purpose.description: These allow us to recognize and count the number of visitors and to see how visitors move around our website when they are using it. This helps us to improve the way our website works, for example, by ensuring that users are finding what they are looking for easily.
purpose.usage: Analytics cookies are used to collect data on how visitors interact with the content. These cookies track metrics such as page views, time spent on pages, and user navigation paths. The gathered information helps the site owner understand which posts are most popular, how users are engaging with the content, and identify areas for improvement to enhance the overall user experience.

sitePurposes.name: Strictly Necessary Cookies
sitePurposes.description: These are cookies that are required for the operation of our website. They include, for example, cookies that enable you to log into secure areas of our website, use an electronic basket or make use of e-billing services.
sitePurposes.usage: First-party cookies are used to remember the items a user adds to their shopping cart. This way, if the user navigates to different pages or returns to the site later, their selected items will still be in the cart, ensuring a seamless shopping experience.

sitePurposes.name: Analytics Cookies

sitePurposes.usage: Analytics cookies are used to collect data on how visitors interact with the content. These cookies track metrics such as page views, time spent on pages, and user navigation paths. The gathered information helps the site owner understand which posts are most popular, how users are engaging with the content, and identify areas for improvement to enhance the overall user experience.

sitePurposes.name: Functional Cookies
sitePurposes.description: These are used to recognize you when you return to our website. This enables us to personalize our content for you (including by saving information which you may have populated into a form, without submitting), greet you by name and remember your preferences (for example, your choice of language or region).
sitePurposes.usage: Personalized cookies are used to enhance user experience by remembering individual preferences and viewing history. These cookies track the shows and movies a user watches and their ratings, enabling the platform to recommend content tailored to their tastes. As a result, users receive a customized browsing experience with suggestions that align with their interests, making it easier to discover new content they`ll likely enjoy.

sitePurposes.description: These cookies record your visit to our website, the pages you have visited and the links you have followed.
